messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Care paths & rollforward: manager notes + OKR alignment

Alex / Marcus —

As we approach the end of the biannual check-in window, a few items I want to land with you both so manager notes and OKR rollforwards are consistent across our org slate:

- Please consolidate one manager-facing summary per direct report (1 page max) using the attached template. Focus on impact, development priorities, and suggested calibration notes.
- Where an IC is likely to change role or scope in the next quarter, mark as a "care-path" candidate and include recommended next-step (stretch, lateral, or support).
- For any performance notes that could trigger a HR review, flag me and Marcus (do not copy HR broadly).

Attaching: manager_notes_template.xlsx.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue (6/30) close-of-day: draft manager summaries in the shared folder
- Wed (7/1) morning: Marcus performs calibration pass and flags any sensitive cases
- Thu (7/2): Leadership calibration (30m) — only leaders and Marcus

Alex — can you take ownership of consolidating the engineering managers' packets? Marcus, I’ll rely on you to surface anything requiring HR.

Thanks,

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: manager_notes_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Care paths & rollforward: manager notes + OKR alignment

Thanks Laura — taking this on. A few quick clarifying notes before I start consolidation:

1) Do we want the manager summaries to include raw calibration scores (1-5) or only qualitative notes? My preference is qualitative + a recommended calibration band to avoid biasing later reviewers.
2) For care-path candidates, should managers propose a concrete 90-day plan or only a suggested option?
3) I’ll reach out to Samantha (Acme) for the two contractors we inherited — do we include external contractor feedback in the same packet or a separate appendix?

I’ll build the folder structure and drop a checklist in the Drive link. Planning to have the first batch (eng managers, ~25 people) by 4pm PT.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Staff Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-30T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Care paths & rollforward: manager notes + OKR alignment

Quick update from my side:

- I’ll do the calibration pass on 7/1 morning as planned. I will flag any items that should be routed to HR (probation concerns, compensation anomalies, or possible performance improvement needs).
- For the contractors from Acme: treat contractor feedback as an appendix and do not include compensation or legal notes in the packet — I’ll coordinate separately with Legal if needed.

Two items to call out that affect the packet structure:
1) Sensitive cases: if a manager anticipates escalating to a formal HR review, include only the neutral facts and recommended next steps — do NOT include medical or legal details in the manager summary. Mark the packet header with [SENSITIVE - HR REVIEW MAY FOLLOW].
2) Calibration band: Alex, please include a recommended band (Low / Mid / High) in the template but don’t publish raw numerical scores. That helps later discussion without anchoring.

I’ve attached a revised rollout spreadsheet with the schedule and a privacy checklist for the leadership meeting.

Marcus
People Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: okrs_rollforward_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Care paths & rollforward: manager notes + OKR alignment

Looping in HR guidance — pulled from privacy and legal:

- Please use the secure Drive folder (link below) for any packet with a sensitive flag. Do not share attachments outside the folder.
- The manager summary should avoid PII beyond role and dates. If medical or legal issues are mentioned, escalate via private HR ticket and do not include those details in the summary.
- For contractors: make sure managers confirm contractual end-dates and scope changes; HR will coordinate any offboarding or extended engagements.

Drive (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4-review-OKRs-REDACTED

Attached: HR privacy checklist and a short note on handling escalations. If any manager anticipates a termination discussion, pause the packet and reach out to me directly — we’ll handle coordination with Legal.

Monica Patel
HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: hr_privacy_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

Received — thanks everyone. Action items for my team:

- I’ll populate the shared folder with manager summaries (eng managers first) by 4pm PT; using qualitative notes + recommended band as discussed.
- I will add contractor feedback to appendix files and mark any care-path candidates with a "SENSITIVE" header if they meet the criteria Marcus outlined.
- Will not include any PII or legal details in the packets; Monica — I’ll flag any pause/termination cases to you privately.

If there are no objections I’ll use the revised schedule Marcus attached and the secure Drive link Monica shared.

—Alex
